matches.title: Sparta Rotterdam vs Feyenoord
matches.description: Watch Sparta Rotterdam vs Feyenoord highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 9, 2026. The Rotterdam derby delivered a captivating encounter at Het Kasteel, where local pride and crucial points were on the line in this early-season Eredivisie clash. On 2026-08-09 , both sides took to the pitch under intense pressure, each seeking to assert their dominance over the city in a match defined by tactical discipline and late-game drama. First-Half Breakthrough The match ignited with a high-tempo opening as both teams looked to seize early momentum. Feyenoord thought they had drawn first blood as early as the 6th minute, but a lengthy VAR review for a potential goal ultimately kept the scoreline level. The visitors continued to press, eventually finding their breakthrough in the 35th minute. Gjivai Zechiel provided a sublime assist for Luciano Valente , who clinicaly finished with his right foot into the bottom corner, giving Feyenoord a deserved lead. Sparta Rotterdam struggled to find their rhythm in the final third, with several promising moves halted by the linesman's flag. Noekkvi Thorisson and Ayoni Santos were both ruled offside as the hosts tried to exploit the high defensive line of the visitors. Tempers began to flare before the break, resulting in a yellow card for Casper Terho following a mistimed challenge. Tactical Shifts and Defensive Grit The second half saw Feyenoord maintaining control, enjoying 61% of the possession, but Sparta Rotterdam remained a threat on the counter. Tactical substitutions played a major role as both managers looked to tip the scales. Feyenoord introduced fresh legs in Shaqueel van Persie and Nacho Ferri , while Sparta brought on Milan Zonneveld to bolster their attacking options. Discipline remained a talking point as Charles Vanhoutte received a yellow card for a cynical foul to stop a burgeoning Sparta attack. Despite numerous corners from Anis Hadj Moussa , the home side's defense stood firm, clearing wave after wave of pressure. As the clock ticked down, the atmosphere among the 10,494 fans grew increasingly tense with the result still hanging in the balance. Late VAR Drama at Het Kasteel The final moments of the match were shrouded in controversy and high emotion. In the 8th minute of stoppage time, Sparta Rotterdam thought they had snatched a dramatic equalizer, leading to wild celebrations in the stands. However, the referee signaled for another VAR check. After a tense wait, the goal was chalked off due to a foul by Milan Zonneveld on Jerry St. Juste . The decision sparked fury among the home side, leading to a yellow card for Mitchell van Bergen for dissent. Despite their late surge, Sparta could not find a way back, and the referee's final whistle confirmed a vital three points for Feyenoord in a derby that lived up to its fierce reputation.
